gloss: to emphasize; to attach importance to; to take seriously

definitions.gloss: to emphasize; to attach importance to; to take seriously
definitions.explanation: To regard something as important or significant and give it priority or special attention. Used when discussing values, policies, and priorities.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}を{重視|じゅうし}する。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は{社員|しゃいん}の{健康|けんこう}を{重視|じゅうし}している。
examples.english: This company places importance on employee health.

examples.japanese: {安全性|あんぜんせい}を{重視|じゅうし}した{設計|せっけい}を{心|こころ}がけています。
examples.english: We strive for designs that prioritize safety.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}よりも{過程|かてい}を{重視|じゅうし}する{教育|きょういく}{方針|ほうしん}に{変|か}わってきた。
examples.english: The educational approach has shifted to one that values process over results.

notes:
A formal word frequently used in business, education, and policy contexts to express what is prioritized or valued. The noun form {重視|じゅうし} often appears in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}{重視|じゅうし}: quality-oriented
- {安全|あんぜん}{重視|じゅうし}: safety-first
- {成果|せいか}{重視|じゅうし}: results-oriented
- {顧客|こきゃく}{重視|じゅうし}: customer-focused
- {実績|じっせき}を{重視|じゅうし}する: to value track record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大切|たいせつ}にする: to value — more personal and emotional
- {重|おも}んじる: to esteem — literary, emphasizes respect
- {軽視|けいし}する: to make light of — the antonym, to treat as unimportant
